title: Vinson
description: vinsonprocess.com Revenue $296.3 Million Vinson Process Systems Company is an American process equipment and engineering firm founded in 1972 in Tulsa, Oklahoma, with over 54 years of experience serving the oil, gas, chemical and petrochemical industries. With approximately 300 to 500 employees across 10 offices in major US energy basins including Houston, Midland, Denver and Williston, it provides separation, heat transfer, compression, pumping and water treatment systems. The company partners with over 50 equipment manufacturers including Emerson, Ariel, Flowserve and Cameron to deliver turnkey process solutions. Its services span process engineering, equipment selection, skid-mounted system integration, commissioning and field service. Family-owned since its founding, it serves upstream, midstream and downstream sectors across North America with modular and custom-designed process packages.
